purpose: Complete screening policies, fixed before the fresh confirmation run (work/fresh/README.md). Fresh data only produce the reported numbers; nothing here is re-fitted or extended afterwards.
n1_base_ranks_note: design() ranks of the fresh GOC 2000 pool (24 ranks evenly spaced by total load), the same six ranks that formed the old calibration set; all six are TEST here
tau_note: mismatch thresholds from work/fulln1/report.log lines 93-95, chosen on the six old calibration bases; shyb (shrunk anchored start) inherits hyb's 5 MW; none re-fitted
loading_cushion_note: decision cutoff for the classical one-step screen (W1) and the anchored screens (W4, shrunk W4); truth stays 1.001; all three reported, none selected
classical_first_note: W1 first; GENCO (anchored start, one step, tau 5 MW, cutoff c) only where W1's one-step mismatch exceeds tau1 or W1 flags; all four reported

mismatch_gate.rule: per outage, evaluate the initial bus mismatch mis0 of the pre-outage start and of the anchored change start; take the start with the smaller mis0 (tie or NaN -> pre-outage), then one Newton step with that start's tau
mismatch_gate.cost: one GENCO inference plus one extra mismatch evaluation per outage

shrinkage.form: start = pre-outage AC voltages + lambda_va*(GENCO(after)-GENCO(before)) on Va and lambda_vm*(...) on Vm, then one Newton step
shrinkage.objective: lambda = sum(dy_true*dy_pred)/sum(dy_pred^2) over mover readings of the CALIBRATION load scenarios of work/splits/policy_splits.json (Va: non-reference buses with true |dVa|>0.1 deg; Vm: PQ buses with true |dVm|>0.001 p.u.), from the sufficient statistics {va,vm}_stp/_spp stored in work/goc<N>/states_hybrid_<ckpt>.parquet; clipped to [0.25, 1.5]. Proxy only: the reported outcome is misses / secure flagged / iterations after one Newton step, never SSE.
shrinkage.amendment: work/splits/README.md 3a said one lambda for Va and Vm from the Va movers; the calibration fit gives lambda_vm > 1 on every checkpoint, so Va and Vm get their own scale. Amended 2026-10-10 before any fresh data existed.

e2e_timing.report: median and p90 per workflow and per gate outcome; excluded: model load, pre-outage AC solve, pre-outage inference

reporting: per policy one table: misses (critical contingencies cleared as secure), secure contingencies sent to AC, share to AC, Newton iterations vs full AC, measured end-to-end ms per outage; no new form or threshold after the run
